dedupe_keys.name: ure liquid fuel infrastructure registers pipelines storage transshipment production fuel stations and transport poland

description: The Polish Energy Regulatory Office (URE) publishes on the national open data portal a set of liquid fuel infrastructure registers built from companies holding a licence or entered in the register of importers. The handed-off dataset gives the types and locations of transmission and distribution pipelines for liquid fuels; sibling datasets from the same office cover storage installations, transshipment installations, production installations, fuel stations, container stations and means of transport. Each is served as JSON through a URE API with a PDF manual, licensed CC0 1.0, marked as updated daily, and the pipeline entry was last modified on 19 March 2024; the portal lists the data since August 2018. Access is free and online without sign-in. Coverage is Poland. Caveats: the pipeline API endpoint returned a server error (HTTP 500) when read on the day, so field contents could not be confirmed, and portal texts are in Polish. Simulation uses are the location and type of fuel pipelines, depots and terminals for fuel supply chain and security of supply models. Related records: data-argentina-hydrocarbon-ducts-res-319-93 is a comparable national pipeline register.
